select 
var.benchmark_name,
var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,
CAST(var.var95 AS decimal(22,6)) as var95,
CAST(b.mean AS decimal(22,6)) as mean,
CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_var
where business_date = '2025-06-06' 
and benchmark_name = 'MRP CORE' and hierarchy_type = 'POOL'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id = 'MRP_CORE'
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-06' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'

and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol 
where business_date = '2025-06-06' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-06' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as d on var.run_id = d.run_id and d.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and d.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and d.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as dv01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-06' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as e on var.run_id = e.run_id and e.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and e.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and e.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_level, pv, run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv 
where business_date = '2025-06-06'
) as f on var.run_id = f.run_id and f.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and f.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and f.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node 
and f.node_level = 1

/* cppi::86537fb832282827a9d0b87588f577bc0d740069ef68f75f689dff8e1d4fc8ef */
select ci.business_date,
    sec.reporting_id_code as deal_code,
    sec.reporting_id_name as deal_name,
    sum(ci.mv_rc) as mv_rc,
    sum(ci.pnl_rc) as pnl_rc,
    sum(ci.pnl_lc) as pnl_lc,
    sum(ci.net_cf_rc) as net_cf_rc
from (
        select business_date,
            aggregation_level_1 as mp_id,
            aggregation_level_3 as sec_id,
            market_value_reporting_currency as mv_rc,
            period_result_node_by_node_reporting_currency as pnl_rc,
            period_result_node_by_node_local as pnl_lc,
            net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as net_cf_rc
        from scd_prod.performance_seclvl_latest psl
            inner join (
                select model_portfolio_id,
                    investment_department_code
                from reference.scd_model_portfolio
                where business_date = (
                        select max(business_date)
                        from reference.scd_model_portfolio
                    )
            ) mp on psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id
        where psl.business_date > '2023-06-30'
            and mp.investment_department_code = 'CREDIT'
    ) ci
    inner join (
        select business_date,
            scd_security_key_id,
            abor_security_id,
            reporting_id_code,
            reporting_id_name
        from reference.scd_securities
        where business_date = (
                select max(business_date)
                from reference.scd_securities
            )
            and reporting_id_code is not null
    ) sec on ci.sec_id = sec.abor_security_id
group by ci.business_date,
    sec.reporting_id_code,
    sec.reporting_id_name
order by ci.business_date,
    sec.reporting_id_code,

SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
            ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
            format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' 
        and business_date>=Date('2025-03-25') and business_date<=Date('2025-05-31')
        UNION
        SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
            ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
            format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join ( 
            SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name

		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded

			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

		select
			  lt_agg.business_date

			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0

	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc

/* QuickSight f000f1bc-f8b0-42bb-9911-e82dd38d74df */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'

			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (

			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (

	from (

			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (

				--, fiscal_date

				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region

				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by

				--, fiscal_date

				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country

				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end

		) lt_agg

	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.abacus_pv_base_ccy,
        f.abacus_notional_base_ccy, 
        f.rm_pv,
        f.abacus_notional_local_ccy,
        f.abacus_pv_local_ccy,
        f.abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
        d.*,
        SPLIT_PART(d.pos_source_system_key, '_', 1) AS parent_key
    FROM 
        risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd f
    LEFT JOIN 
        risk_prod.dim_pos_inst d
    ON 
        f.pos_id = d.pos_id AND f.business_date = d.business_date
    LEFT JOIN    
        (SELECT * FROM risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node 
         WHERE hierarchy_type = 'RISK' AND business_date = '2025-06-05') X
    ON
        X.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id AND X.business_date = d.business_date
    WHERE 
        f.business_date = '{BUSINESS_DATE}' 
        AND d.pos_source_system_key NOT LIKE '%OFFSET%' 
        AND d.portfolio_type IN ('IP')--,'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH','LOOKTHROUGH')
       -- AND (
    --        (d.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' AND d.cppib_product_type IN ('Equity Swap','Equity Futures'))
   --         OR d.portfolio_type IN ('IP', 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH')
  --      )
),
value_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_key,
        COUNT(*) AS parent_key_count
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY parent_key
),
ip_with_flag AS (
    SELECT 
        b.*,
        vc.parent_key_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.portfolio_type = 'IP' AND vc.parent_key_count > 2 THEN 'NO'
            ELSE 'YES'
        END AS KEEP
    FROM base_data b
    LEFT JOIN value_counts vc
    ON b.parent_key = vc.parent_key
),
sa_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|', 3) AS Department,
        SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|', 4) AS Strategy,
        SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|', 5) AS Sub_Strategy,
        SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|', 13) AS ptfl_acct_code
    FROM risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node
    WHERE hierarchy_type = 'SA' 
      AND business_date = '2025-06-05' 
      AND node_level = 12
)
SELECT 
    ip.*,
    sa.Department,
    sa.Strategy,
    sa.Sub_Strategy
FROM ip_with_flag ip
LEFT JOIN sa_hierarchy sa
ON ip.ptfl_acct_code = sa.ptfl_acct_code

/* cppi::bcffd6eb7c872f5efb4eb1a23af17cd72541677be0347843a9711b0b42d0b3fc */
/* QuickSight acce3841-ff57-4dfa-a008-1309a78e766b */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date

/* cppi::bcffd6eb7c872f5efb4eb1a23af17cd72541677be0347843a9711b0b42d0b3fc */
/* QuickSight acce3841-ff57-4dfa-a008-1309a78e766b */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)) AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code     != 'BalBook' -- come back to this
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number
),
latest_transactions AS (
     SELECT CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)        AS business_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE)  AS period_closure_date,
            t.abor_security_id
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN latest_abor_transactions lat
         ON t.abor_transaction_number     = lat.abor_transaction_number
        AND CAST(t.business_date AS DATE) = lat.business_date
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON t.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag     = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code        != 'BalBook'
),
latest_total_buys_and_sells AS(
     SELECT abor_security_id,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy') 
                   THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
                   THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad
       FROM latest_transactions
      WHERE period_closure_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', business_date)
        AND period_closure_date <= DATE(DATE_TRUNC('quarter', business_date) + INTERVAL '3' MONTH - INTERVAL '1' DAY)
   GROUP BY abor_security_id
),
latest_holdings AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
            s.country_of_exposure_name,
            mp.developed_or_emerging,
            h.abor_security_id,
            h.abor_security_name,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            h.abor_country_of_exposure_name,
            h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
            h.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
            h.exposure_portfolio_currency,
            tbs.total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad        AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            tbs.total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad       AS permanent_roc_historical,
            h.quotation_currency_code
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON h.cppib_sec_id                                       = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN latest_total_buys_and_sells tbs
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = tbs.abor_security_id
      WHERE asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4       NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'
),
ra_deals AS (
     SELECT business_date                                                 AS business_date,
            CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                            AS as_of_date,
            abor_security_id                                              AS investment_code,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_aggregate_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS reporting_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS allocation_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS model_portfolio_name,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
            'Other'                                                       AS investment_structure,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_stage,
            country_of_exposure_name                                      AS geographic_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_3                            AS sector_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_4                            AS sub_sector_focus,
            'Real Assets'                                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                                          AS business_unit,
            quotation_currency_code                                       AS local_reporting_currency,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_count,
            developed_or_emerging                                         AS developed_emerging_country,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name                     AS investment_manager,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS allocation,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS commitments,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                  AS uncommitted_allocation,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS gross_invested_equity,
            CAST(gross_invested_equity_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))      AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS expenses_inside_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS capital_additions,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS temporary_roc,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS temporary_roc_historical,
            CAST(balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS invested_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS unfunded_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
            CAST(permanent_roc_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))              AS permanent_roc_historical,
            CAST(balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS net_invested_equity,
            CAST(dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS asset_carrying_value,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS debt_carrying_value,
            CAST(dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS equity_carrying_value,
            CAST(exposure_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))           AS exposure,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS occupied_area,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS total_area,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS active_or_liquidated
       FROM latest_holdings
)
    SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS "Reporting Period",
           investment_code                                      AS "Investment Code",
           investment_name                                      AS "Legal Entity Name",
           investment_aggregate_name                            AS "Investment Name",
           reporting_name                                       AS "Reporting Name",
           allocation_name                                      AS "Allocation Name",
           model_portfolio_name                                 AS "Herbi Name",
           cppib_ownership_percentage / 100                     AS "CPPIB Percentage Ownership",
           COALESCE(investment_structure, 'N/A')                AS "Investment Structure",
           COALESCE(investment_stage, 'N/A')                    AS "Investment Stage - Current",
           COALESCE(geographic_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Geographic Focus",
           COALESCE(sector_focus, 'N/A')                        AS "Sector",
           COALESCE(sub_sector_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Subsector",
           COALESCE(investment_department, 'N/A')               AS "Business Group",
           COALESCE(investment_group, 'N/A')                    AS "Business Subgroup",
           COALESCE(business_unit, 'N/A')                       AS "Business Unit",
           COALESCE(local_reporting_currency, 'N/A')            AS "Investment Reporting Currency",
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                AS "Realized / Unrealized",
           investment_count                                     AS "Investment Count",
           COALESCE(developed_emerging_country, 'N/A')          AS "Developed/Emerging Country",
           COALESCE(investment_manager, 'N/A')                  AS "Investment Manager",
           allocation                                           AS "Allocations",
           commitments                                          AS "Commitment",
           uncommitted_allocation                               AS "Uncommitted Allocation",
           gross_invested_equity                                AS "Gross Invested Equity (Converted @ Current FX)",
           expenses_inside_commitment                           AS "Expenses Inside Commitment (Converted @ Current FX)",
           capital_additions                                    AS "Capital Additions (Converted @ Current FX)",
           temporary_roc                                        AS "Temporary ROC (Converted @ Current FX)",
           invested_commitment                                  AS "Invested Commitment",
           unfunded_commitment                                  AS "Unfunded Commitment",
           gross_invested_equity_historical                     AS "Gross Invested Equity (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           temporary_roc_historical                             AS "Temporary ROC (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           permanent_roc_historical                             AS "Permanent ROC (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           net_invested_equity                                  AS "Net Invested Equity",
           asset_carrying_value                                 AS "Asset Carrying Value",
           debt_carrying_value                                  AS "Debt Carrying Value",
           equity_carrying_value                                AS "Equity Carrying Value",
           exposure                                             AS "Exposure",
           occupied_area                                        AS "Occupied Area",
           total_area                                           AS "Total Area",
           active_or_liquidated                                 AS "Active or Liquidated"
      FROM ra_deals r
     WHERE r.business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
       AND r.investment_code IN ('ELI BB', '.ELI_R BB', '.ADP-R FP', 'CLNX SM', '.ELI24_R BB')
  ORDER BY r.investment_code ASC

 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)) AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code     != 'BalBook' -- come back to this
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number
),
latest_transactions AS (
     SELECT CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)        AS business_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE)  AS period_closure_date,
            t.abor_security_id
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN latest_abor_transactions lat
         ON t.abor_transaction_number     = lat.abor_transaction_number
        AND CAST(t.business_date AS DATE) = lat.business_date
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON t.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag     = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code        != 'BalBook'
),
latest_total_buys_and_sells AS(
     SELECT abor_security_id,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy') 
                   THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
                   THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad
       FROM latest_transactions
      WHERE period_closure_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', business_date)
        AND period_closure_date <= DATE(DATE_TRUNC('quarter', business_date) + INTERVAL '3' MONTH - INTERVAL '1' DAY)
   GROUP BY abor_security_id
),
latest_holdings AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
            s.country_of_exposure_name,
            mp.developed_or_emerging,
            h.abor_security_id,
            h.abor_security_name,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            h.abor_country_of_exposure_name,
            h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
            h.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
            h.exposure_portfolio_currency,
            tbs.total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad        AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            tbs.total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad       AS permanent_roc_historical,
            h.quotation_currency_code
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON h.cppib_sec_id                                       = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN latest_total_buys_and_sells tbs
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = tbs.abor_security_id
      WHERE asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4       NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'
),
ra_deals AS (
     SELECT business_date                                                 AS business_date,
            CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                            AS as_of_date,
            abor_security_id                                              AS investment_code,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_aggregate_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS reporting_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS allocation_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS model_portfolio_name,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
            'Other'                                                       AS investment_structure,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_stage,
            country_of_exposure_name                                      AS geographic_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_3                            AS sector_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_4                            AS sub_sector_focus,
            'Real Assets'                                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                                          AS business_unit,
            quotation_currency_code                                       AS local_reporting_currency,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_count,
            developed_or_emerging                                         AS developed_emerging_country,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name                     AS investment_manager,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS allocation,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS commitments,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                  AS uncommitted_allocation,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS gross_invested_equity,
            CAST(gross_invested_equity_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))      AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS expenses_inside_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS capital_additions,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS temporary_roc,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS temporary_roc_historical,
            CAST(balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS invested_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS unfunded_commitment,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
            CAST(permanent_roc_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))              AS permanent_roc_historical,
            CAST(balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS net_invested_equity,
            CAST(dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS asset_carrying_value,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS debt_carrying_value,
            CAST(dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS equity_carrying_value,
            CAST(exposure_portfolio_currency AS DECIMAL(32, 2))           AS exposure,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS occupied_area,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS total_area,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS active_or_liquidated
       FROM latest_holdings
)
    SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS "Reporting Period",
           investment_code                                      AS "Investment Code",
           investment_name                                      AS "Legal Entity Name",
           investment_aggregate_name                            AS "Investment Name",
           reporting_name                                       AS "Reporting Name",
           allocation_name                                      AS "Allocation Name",
           model_portfolio_name                                 AS "Herbi Name",
           cppib_ownership_percentage / 100                     AS "CPPIB Percentage Ownership",
           COALESCE(investment_structure, 'N/A')                AS "Investment Structure",
           COALESCE(investment_stage, 'N/A')                    AS "Investment Stage - Current",
           COALESCE(geographic_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Geographic Focus",
           COALESCE(sector_focus, 'N/A')                        AS "Sector",
           COALESCE(sub_sector_focus, 'N/A')                    AS "Subsector",
           COALESCE(investment_department, 'N/A')               AS "Business Group",
           COALESCE(investment_group, 'N/A')                    AS "Business Subgroup",
           COALESCE(business_unit, 'N/A')                       AS "Business Unit",
           COALESCE(local_reporting_currency, 'N/A')            AS "Investment Reporting Currency",
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                AS "Realized / Unrealized",
           investment_count                                     AS "Investment Count",
           COALESCE(developed_emerging_country, 'N/A')          AS "Developed/Emerging Country",
           COALESCE(investment_manager, 'N/A')                  AS "Investment Manager",
           allocation                                           AS "Allocations",
           commitments                                          AS "Commitment",
           uncommitted_allocation                               AS "Uncommitted Allocation",
           gross_invested_equity                                AS "Gross Invested Equity (Converted @ Current FX)",
           expenses_inside_commitment                           AS "Expenses Inside Commitment (Converted @ Current FX)",
           capital_additions                                    AS "Capital Additions (Converted @ Current FX)",
           temporary_roc                                        AS "Temporary ROC (Converted @ Current FX)",
           invested_commitment                                  AS "Invested Commitment",
           unfunded_commitment                                  AS "Unfunded Commitment",
           gross_invested_equity_historical                     AS "Gross Invested Equity (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           temporary_roc_historical                             AS "Temporary ROC (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           permanent_roc_historical                             AS "Permanent ROC (Converted @ Historical FX)",
           net_invested_equity                                  AS "Net Invested Equity",
           asset_carrying_value                                 AS "Asset Carrying Value",
           debt_carrying_value                                  AS "Debt Carrying Value",
           equity_carrying_value                                AS "Equity Carrying Value",
           exposure                                             AS "Exposure",
           occupied_area                                        AS "Occupied Area",
           total_area                                           AS "Total Area",
           active_or_liquidated                                 AS "Active or Liquidated"
      FROM ra_deals r
     WHERE r.business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
       AND r.investment_code IN ('ELI BB', '.ELI_R BB', '.ADP-R FP', 'CLNX SM', '.ELI24_R BB')
  ORDER BY r.investment_code ASC
